project_type: Hybrid local-first desktop product: Rust Cargo workspace (headless daemon apps/litecoworkd + 14 domain/storage/runtime crates) + Tauri v2 + React/TS desktop UI (apps/litecowork-ui) + a Python uv capabilities slice (capabilities/zip_intake). THIS TASK is a documentation audit + competitor research + gap-analysis effort, not a code change. Code may be read READ-ONLY to verdict a doc claim; the deliverable is durable documentation changes in the repo's own voice/format obeying its authority model.
language: Rust (primary runtime), TypeScript/React (UI), Python (capabilities + doc audit scripts). The audited artifacts are Markdown + JSON/YAML/SQL schema files.
build_system: Cargo workspace (cargo) + uv (Python) + pnpm (UI). Doc validation is Python scripts under scripts/ plus corpus_audit.py at repo root. On this Linux sandbox cargo/uv need the prefix: TMPDIR=/tmp PKG_CONFIG_SYSROOT_DIR=/tmp/sysroot PKG_CONFIG_PATH=/tmp/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu/pkgconfig LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/sysroot/usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu. For a DOC task the relevant gates are the Python audit scripts and the markdown/design-depth/consistency validators, which do NOT need the cargo prefix.
test_framework: For docs: scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py (broken relative links), scripts/audit_v1_design_depth.py (design-depth findings + file/line counts), scripts/validate_architecture.py (JSON Schema, event schemas, OpenAPI structure, SQL, Gateway naming, concept + active Markdown), scripts/validate_design_owner_consistency.py (cross-owner consistency assertions), scripts/audit_v1_contracts.py (OpenAPI operation count: served/target-only), scripts/audit_served_routes.py (served-route-inventory.json), .specify/scripts/validate_feature_package.py (11 SDD packages), and corpus_audit.py at repo root. Generated docs are regenerated via build_v1_function_contract_ledger.py, build_v1_settings_ledger.py, build_active_corpus_inventory.py, sync_audit_inventory_v1.py. scripts/check.sh is the composite gate (has a --preflight mode).
build_command: No compile needed for the doc deliverable. To regenerate generated docs run their generators (python3 scripts/build_active_corpus_inventory.py, build_v1_function_contract_ledger.py, build_v1_settings_ledger.py, sync_audit_inventory_v1.py). NEVER hand-edit a generated artifact; a drift gate must pass.
test_command: Doc gates: python3 scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py; python3 scripts/audit_v1_design_depth.py; python3 scripts/validate_architecture.py; python3 scripts/validate_design_owner_consistency.py; python3 .specify/scripts/validate_feature_package.py; python3 corpus_audit.py. If scripts/check.sh works in-sandbox, prefer it as the composite gate. Any script that imports cargo/rust toolchain needs the sandbox prefix above.
verification_instructions: After each doc-authoring feature: (1) run python3 scripts/audit_v1_markdown.py and confirm 0 broken relative links; (2) run python3 scripts/validate_design_owner_consistency.py and confirm 0 issues; (3) if any generated doc was touched, regenerate it via its generator and confirm the freshness/drift gate passes (never hand-edit); (4) run python3 scripts/audit_v1_design_depth.py and reconcile the reported file/line counts against any doc that cites them (CURRENT-RUN.md, COMPLETE-ACTIVE-CORPUS-INVENTORY.md). The known drift to fix: CURRENT-RUN.md cites 54,687/54,599 lines but generated audits report 54,701/54,613 (~14-line drift).
snapshot_or_generated_files: Generated/never-hand-edit: docs/audit/* , docs/COVERAGE-MATRIX.md (if generated), docs/COMPLETE-ACTIVE-CORPUS-INVENTORY.md (built by scripts/build_active_corpus_inventory.py, excludes itself), docs/V1-FUNCTION-CONTRACT-LEDGER.md (build_v1_function_contract_ledger.py), docs/V1-SETTINGS-CONTRACT-LEDGER.md (build_v1_settings_ledger.py), docs/schemas/served-route-inventory.json (scripts/audit_served_routes.py). Regenerate via the named generator; do not hand-edit. reading/ and .zwork/ are already-tracked prior digests (known hygiene wart) and are EXCLUDED from the active corpus manifest/markdown audit; do NOT add more files there.
setup_instructions: Repo already cloned at /projects/sandbox/litecowork on branch main (clean, HEAD 2e85f03). DO NOT re-clone the LiteCowork repo. Create a feature branch for all work. Competitor repos clone with `git clone --depth 1 <url>` into repo_take/ (gitignored, line 38 of .gitignore) ONLY; record the exact resolved commit SHA for each; never stage repo_take/ clones.
environment_constraints: Network IS OPEN (github.com -> 200, code.claude.com/docs/en/desktop -> 200). Free web search + web fetch authorized by the user. git, gh, rg, python3, cargo, uv present. The coder subagent CANNOT push or open PRs; the orchestrator publishes afterward. Leave work committed on a feature branch ready to push. corpus_audit.py at repo root failed to run under the OS sandbox in one probe; the coder should retry and, if it stays blocked, fall back to scripts/ audit scripts and note the limitation. Cargo/uv commands need the TMPDIR/PKG_CONFIG prefix; but the doc deliverable does not require a Rust build.
contribution_requirements: STRICT single-owner authority model (from docs/README.md + ARCHITECTURE.md + SPECIFICATION-STANDARD.md): ARCHITECTURE.md (constitution) > PRODUCT.md / V1-PRODUCT-RELEASE-CONTRACT.md > domain owner contracts + accepted ADRs > docs/schemas/ (canonical machine contracts) > V1 UI contracts/ledgers/coverage maps (traceability only) > IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md (source-backed status) > CODE/SYSTEM/USER qualification evidence > IMPLEMENTATION-MASTER-PLAN.md. ONE normative definition per concept; supporting docs LINK to the owner, never redefine. NEVER create a competing CONSTITUTION.md. Update competitor intel IN PLACE in the five existing owner docs (COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH.md, VIABILITY-VS-COMPETITORS.md, COMPETITOR-PROMOTED-USE-CASES.md, REFERENCE-IMPLEMENTATIONS.md, REFERENCE-REPOS-CORE-ARCHITECTURE-INDEX.md) rather than creating duplicates; create a NEW doc only if no owner exists for a concept (the Phase 3 superset matrix is the one genuinely new concept). Evidence vocabulary TARGET/CODE/SERVED/INTEGRATED/QUALIFIED must be used precisely; never let a route/mock/test/UI tile masquerade as shipped. Never rewrite a historical doc's date/status. Research discipline: record source, EXACT version/commit SHA, date checked, observed fact, interpretation, limitation; a mutable URL alone is insufficient; point to exact file URLs for borrowable code; respect LICENSE (PolyForm Noncommercial = reference/UX study only, no commercial code reuse; Elastic/SUL restricted; MIT/Apache permissive with attribution).
key_patterns: ID allocation is global and append-only. NEXT UNUSED IDs: contradiction/alignment A-51 (highest existing A-50); blocking decision B-34 (highest existing B-33); research-gate RV-13 (highest existing RV-12 in VIABILITY-VS-COMPETITORS.md). UC-xx ids in COMPETITOR-PROMOTED-USE-CASES.md use semantic suffixes (UC-CHAT-01, UC-MEM-, UC-WORK-, UC-TRM-, UC-SKL-, UC-MCP-, UC-ORG-, UC-SET-, UC-VOICE-) not a single running integer. Register row format is a markdown table: | ID | Area | Current authoritative statement | Consequence |. RV register format: | RV-xx | Gate | detail | **STATUS** — [owner links] |. UC format: | UC-ID | Promoted by | User journey | LiteCowork test when | Notes |. Each contradiction is resolved AT the owner doc, and the register links to it. KNOWN DRIFT/DANGLERS to reconcile: A-38 (FLOWS.md index omits F115-F124, F136-F143 and duplicates F119 as F128), A-39 (UIV1-001..158 cited by FLOWS/COVERAGE-MATRIX/COMPETITIVE-RESEARCH/TESTING but defined only in docs/archive/legacy-implementation-c7e9c05/), A-40 (sqlite-v28.sql exists but SCHEMA_VERSION=27 so unreachable, yet COVERAGE-MATRIX cites it), line-count drift in CURRENT-RUN.md.
